history_semantics: Every available scalar row, with original global steps and unchanged values.
wandb_semantics: Native offline run was converted from source console metrics; SDK timestamps are conversion time.
raw_rollouts: Original per-step rollout dump was disabled. No synthetic trajectories are substituted.
resume_checkpoint: Step725 actor, optimizer and dataloader state are private historical assets, not shipped.
task_focus: systematic same-token rollout/actor logprob shift; independent anomalies separately attributed

diagnostic_replay.source: preserved original recorded replay, authored compact projection

historical_grader.origin: byte-identical extraction from original immutable runtime; independently matched to preserved buggy source

shared_image_replay.semantics: Separate fixed-token inference replay; original training history remains from its recorded runtime.
